paragraphs.text: Károly and Meg are at a gathering with friends and family. The room is full.
They look at the things in the room.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A könyvek itt vannak. Az asztalok ott vannak.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: A székek ott vannak. Az ajtók kicsik.
The friends and the children have arrived.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A barátok és a gyerekek együtt vannak.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Igen, az emberek mind együtt vannak.
Some things are big, some are small, some are new and some are old.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A nagy asztalok és a kicsi székek.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Az új könyvek és a régi könyvek.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Néhány szék van itt. Több szék kell.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Igen, több szék kell. A család itt van.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Sok barát van itt. Szép csoport!

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where are Károly and Meg?
options: At a gathering of friends and family
In a shop full of books
At a school with many children
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The narration says Károly and Meg are at a gathering with friends and family, and Károly says Sok ember van itt (There are many people here).

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does Meg say is needed?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: Meg says Néhány szék van itt. Több szék kell. (A few chairs are here. More chairs are needed.)

comprehensionQuestions.question: Who is together, according to Meg?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: Meg says A barátok és a gyerekek együtt vannak. (The friends and the children are together.)
